questions.q: Eruptions with thick, hard crusts under which yellow pus collects, intense itching, and neuralgia after herpes zoster suggest:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Mezereum: crusts with pus beneath, post-herpetic neuralgia.

questions.q: Metformin is contraindicated when the eGFR falls below:
questions.why: Because of the risk of lactic acidosis, metformin is stopped below an eGFR of 30, and the dose is reviewed or reduced between 30 and 45.

questions.q: The population norm for one Primary Health Centre in hilly, tribal or difficult areas is:
questions.why: A PHC covers 30,000 in plains and 20,000 in hilly or tribal areas; 80,000 is the CHC norm for hilly areas.

questions.q: A lesion of the primary visual cortex of one occipital lobe typically produces:
opts: total blindness of the eye on the same side
contralateral homonymous hemianopia with macular sparing
questions.why: The visual cortex receives the opposite half-field of both eyes; the macula is often spared owing to dual blood supply. Bitemporal loss is from the optic chiasma.

questions.q: Which remedy is inimical to Mercurius and should not follow it?
questions.why: Boericke lists Silicea as incompatible with Mercurius; Hepar is its antidote.

questions.q: Haemoglobin in a large adult sample is normally distributed with mean 12 g/dL and standard deviation 1 g/dL. About what proportion lies between 10 and 14 g/dL?
questions.why: 10-14 is mean +/- 2 SD, which covers about 95% of a normal distribution; +/- 1 SD covers 68%.

questions.q: According to §270, the vial in which an LM potency is succussed should be filled to about:
questions.why: Hahnemann specified a vial two-thirds full, leaving room for the liquid to be struck forcefully during the 100 succussions.

questions.q: Under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) 2023, hurt that causes severe bodily pain or inability to follow ordinary pursuits is grievous when it lasts for at least:
questions.why: BNS section 116 reduced the period from the 20 days of IPC 320 to 15 days.

questions.q: MacRepertory, which uses the Complete Repertory, was created by:
questions.why: MacRepertory is David Warkentin's software; van Zandvoort compiled the Complete Repertory used in it.

questions.q: Haemorrhoids that bleed and protrude like a bunch of grapes, relieved by cold water, with a sense of insecurity of the rectum, suggest:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Aloe: grape-like piles, cold water relieves, unsure sphincter.
